evals.prompt: Inspect this .vsdx and tell me what pages, shapes, text, masters, and connectors it contains.
evals.expected_output: Uses the visio skill, runs structural inspection, summarizes pages/masters/text/edges, and does not rely on raw grep for XML text.

evals.prompt: Change the label on one Visio process box, preserve the rest of the drawing, and give me back an editable .vsdx.
evals.expected_output: Keeps the original untouched, unpacks the package, performs a targeted XML edit, validates, repacks, and calls out visual QA limitations if Visio/rendering is unavailable.

evals.prompt: This file has a .zip extension but I think it is a Visio drawing. Can you read it?
evals.expected_output: Treats misnamed OOXML ZIPs as possible Visio packages, checks [Content_Types].xml and relationships, validates, and explains the package structure.
